name: app-health-home-analytics-and-assistant-screens-presentation
title: Health Home, Assistant and Analytics Screens
whatItIs: A light board with two large tiles, a pale one with a headline and the health home phone and a black one with an AI assistant phone showing a gradient orb, plus an analytics phone and enlarged calorie and walking cards.
whatItMeans: Contrasting a pale and a black tile shows the same product in two moods, and enlarged cards reveal detail.
techniques: Light and black tiles side by side
Gradient orb as the assistant's face
Enlarged component cards beside the phone
Section label pills above each screen
Sunburst score and coloured icons per metric

vocabulary.definition: A small rounded label naming a section.
A UI piece shown large beside the full screen.
A glossy sphere representing an AI assistant.
